# Multiplayer Concurrency & Governance Requirements Quality Checklist: Playable Compost Loop

**Purpose**: Validate the requirements quality (Completeness, Clarity, Consistency, Measurability, Coverage, Edge Cases) of multiplayer concurrency, Principle VI compliance, and race condition specifications in `specs/004-playable-compost-loop/spec.md`.
**Created**: 2026-10-04
**Feature**: [Playable Compost Loop](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Principle VI Governance & Architectural Alignment

- [x] CHK001 Does the specification define how host-authoritative ownership applies to both bin machine state and tile soil health without ambiguity between host and farmhand execution contexts? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018, §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK002 Are save/host data scoping rules explicitly articulated to prevent client-side divergence or fragmented save data on farmhand machines? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK003 Does the spec reconcile the boundary between single-player and multiplayer behavior such that single-player is consistently specified as a degenerate case rather than a separate code path? [Consistency, Spec §FR-018, Constitution §VI]
- [x] CHK004 Does the spec quantify the exact scope of document remediation required for reconciling prior specifications and plans with Principle VI? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017, §SC-007]

## Concurrency & Race Condition Requirements

- [x] CHK005 Is "first action to take effect wins" defined with deterministic operational criteria (e.g., host tick ordering, lock acquisition, or event sequence) so that conflict resolution is unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, §FR-019]
- [x] CHK006 Does the specification explicitly define what constitutes an "attempt" when two players interact simultaneously with the same composting bin (e.g., loading organic waste concurrently)? [Edge Cases, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-019]
- [x] CHK007 Does the specification explicitly define the concurrent conflict behavior when two players attempt to collect compost from the same matured bin at the same time? [Edge Cases, Spec §FR-005b, §FR-019]
- [x] CHK008 Does the specification explicitly define the race condition outcome when one player attempts to remove/pick up a bin while another player is loading or collecting from it? [Edge Cases, Spec §FR-005c, §FR-019]
- [x] CHK009 Does the specification define the resolution and rollback state when two players simultaneously apply compost to the same tilled tile near its maximum capacity (e.g., health at 90 with +20 boost)? [Edge Cases, Spec §FR-008, §FR-019]
- [x] CHK010 Are item consumption atomicity rules specified so that a refused concurrent action guarantees zero loss of organic waste or compost items from the rejected player's inventory? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, §FR-019, §SC-009]

## Day Advancement & Synchronization Clarity

- [x] CHK011 Is the exact mechanism or game event trigger for "advancing one in-game day" specified so that batch processing advances exactly once regardless of player count or staggered sleep events? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, §SC-005]
- [x] CHK012 Does the specification define the timing and state consistency of daily soil decay when multiple players are in different locations or disconnected during the overnight tick? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK013 Does the specification define expected behavior if a farmhand disconnects or reconnects mid-day while bins are processing or compost is being applied? [Edge Cases, Spec §FR-004, §FR-018]

## Refusal Messaging in Multiplayer Scenarios

- [x] CHK014 Is the delivery mechanism of refusal messages specified to ensure the message is targeted exclusively to the rejected player rather than broadcast to all players? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008a, §FR-019]
- [x] CHK015 Are the refusal message keys or semantic explanations for concurrent conflict rejections specifically defined (e.g., distinct wording for "tile already fertilized" vs "action conflicted with another player")? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008a, §FR-019]
- [x] CHK016 Does the requirement specify how localized/translated text is resolved when host and farmhand run different game language settings? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008a, §Assumptions]

## Acceptance Criteria & Verification Bounds

- [x] CHK017 Is the verification gap between single-player automated testing and multiplayer manual testing bounded with unambiguous testability criteria in the success criteria? [Measurability, Spec §SC-010, §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK018 Does SC-010 define measurable and repeatable test steps for verifying simultaneous two-player actions and refusal messaging? [Measurability, Spec §SC-010]
- [x] CHK019 Is there an objective criterion for verifying that zero orphaned or split state remains when a bin placed by a farmhand is removed by the host or vice versa? [Measurability, Spec §FR-002, §FR-005c, §SC-004]
- [x] CHK020 Does the specification define measurable verification criteria for ensuring farmhand render updates (visual soil health changes) stay synchronized without polling lag or desync? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010, §FR-018]
